body.name: Fang--Ridder--Xie penalty correspondence
body.construction: At a deterministic coordinate \(c\in\mathcal C\), identify this proposal's direct KL penalty with the comparator's optimization penalty by \(\lambda_{\mathrm{FRX}}=c\). The corresponding preference reported by FangRidderXie2026 is therefore \(c_{\mathrm{FRX}}=\lambda_{\mathrm{FRX}}/s_W^{\mathrm{FRX}}=c/s_W^{\mathrm{FRX}}\). The common-submodel comparison restricts their admissible-rule framework to the finite-action benchmark-centered softmax subclass \(\{\pi_\theta:\theta\in\Theta\}\).
